text.p: Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Friday it raised its rating on Norwood Promotional Products Inc stock to buy from hold, adding that it thought the share price had reached bottom.
-- Norwood shares were up 3/4 at 14-1/4 early Friday afternoon, compared with a 52-week low of 12-1/2.

-- "The company's announcement that earnings would fall short of analysts' estimates in the fourth quarter due to an acquisition gone bad came as no surprise to us," Rodman said in a report. "We had already lowered our estimate $0.10 below the company's suggested range after the second-quarter report."

-- Norwood, a supplier of promotional items imprinted with the name logo or message of advertisers, on Thursday said it expected to report eanrings of about $0.20 to $0.25 a share for the fourth quarter ending August 31.
